_comment: Which task families and styles are never trained on. Committed so the claim 'following criteria it has never seen' is auditable. Changing this changes every split, so do it before any training run. val_task_families are used only for model selection (the val-tasks split) and are disjoint from task_families, so selecting a checkpoint never touches the test families.

task_families.coco.dominant_supercategory: photo, choice: needs reading the option descriptions, not memorising labels
task_families.comp.photo.more_of: photo, bool: comparing two counts, a structure never seen in training
task_families.doc.merchant_type: document, choice: business type from receipt content
task_families.comp.doc.total_between: document, bool: range test on a number read from the page
task_families.comp.screen.form_and_captcha: screenshot, bool: a conjunction of two UI facts

val_task_families.comp.photo.or: photo, bool: a disjunction of two objects
val_task_families.doc.has_table: document, bool: spotting a ruled table
val_task_families.web.cookie_banner: screenshot, bool: a banner at the page edge
val_task_families.quality.noise: all domains, score: grain and noise
